Appendix A, instant payout research. Public pricing checked 2026-04-08 shows Stripe at 1.5% (min $0.50), Square at 1.75% and Shopify Payments at 1.5%, while Helcim has no instant product, and none advertise a cap. All three that offer it make the net amount the most prominent number before confirmation: Stripe shows amount, fee and net in a modal, Square shows the fee under an Instant/Standard toggle, and Shopify puts the net in the confirm button. Across 148 public posts (Oct 2025 to Apr 2026), merchants most often report payouts marked sent but not received (41), fees charged on failed instant payouts (23), cards ruled ineligible without explanation (19) and instant disabled after a risk review without notice (15). Payments Canada's Real-Time Rail is in final testing with a limited phased launch targeted for 2026, so card-based instant payouts stay the practical rail through at least 2026.

Action: put this into the PRD as the appendix and link the saved screenshots and complaint quotes in Drive.

Complaints: payouts marked sent but not received, fees on failed instant payouts, and unexplained card ineligibility lead the themes, and Real-Time Rail is limited to phased 2026 access so cards stay the practical rail. Action: paste this into the PRD as an appendix with source links to the Drive research folder.
